title: When You’re Too Drunk To Realise You Just Hit A Police Car
description:
On June 15th, 2022, officers responded to an accident involving a police car. The officer advised that the lady had reversed and hit the front of his car. The woman was severely impaired and was going to have a lot of difficulty performing the DUI test. The woman was also going to struggle with blowing into the breathalyzer, but she would attempt to excuse herself from the situation by claiming she doesn't have organs. She made a sensible decision by not arguing with the cops, as arguing, like many suspects do, tends to only escalate the situation. The female was charged with DUI

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.
